title: 第 2150 章 不知岁月的鏖战打破平衡胜第 2149 章 兵戈争锋肉身搏杀
slug: 儒道至上我在异界背唐诗
content_zh:
若是换作诸天任何一位同境修士，承受这般裹挟大道法理的兵戈创伤，早已经脉断裂、道基受损，重伤濒死、战力尽失，哪怕是上古顶尖天骄，也绝无可能负重再战。
可二人皆是肉身证道、以身代天的无上存在，周身肌理道纹圆满无漏，肉身坚韧程度远超诸天极限，早已超脱凡俗修士的伤势桎梏。
这些足以震杀同境的致命伤势，落在二人身上，仅仅只是皮肉之伤、肌理之损，根本无法撼动本源道基，更无法阻滞分毫战力。
枪来剑往，攻势依旧迅猛凌厉、势破苍穹，进退之间依旧沉稳有度、行云流水，周身杀伐战意不曾衰减半分，唯有满身血泽，见证着这场鏖战的凶险。
看似旗鼓相当、平分秋色的战局，唯有身处对局中心的词宋心知肚明，二者的底蕴差距，早已在无数次交锋中悄然显露。
对手的肉身大道圆满成熟、趋近极致，可终究是困于诸天法理的凡尘道途，底蕴有尽、上限有顶；而自己身负道初本源、天道余威，历经仙道绝巅重修，道途无界、底蕴无垠。
自开战以来，他始终稳稳压制对方一线，每一次对撞都能悄无声息卸掉对方三成力道，每一次交错都能凭借本源层级碾压对方道韵，看似相持不下，实则对方步步被动、节节勉强，全程被他隐隐制衡。
差距细微，却真实存在，日积月累，便是天壤之别。
千招转瞬即逝，万招匆匆而过。
光阴在厮杀中失去意义，时间长河滔滔奔流，无人计数昼夜更迭。
时光悄然流逝，二人始终在光阴夹缝中极速鏖战，枪剑从未停歇，战意从未凋零。
二人苦战，对手的攻势渐渐不复最初的凌厉迅猛，起落之间多了几分隐晦的滞涩，肉身底蕴的消耗愈发明显；而词宋依旧进退从容、攻势沉稳，道力流转生生不息，无半分枯竭之态。
时光再逝，不知经历多久的漫长鏖战，横跨无尽岁月的极致争锋，终于磨尽了最后的持平假象。
轰隆！
时间长河上游的光影悄然偏移，最后一次枪剑极致对撞炸开滔天气浪。
这一次，漆黑寂灭龙枪剧烈震颤，枪身萦绕的万古龙纹成片崩碎，雄浑霸道的时序道力骤然断层、后继无力。
神秘人影身形剧烈一晃，踉跄倒退数丈，周身翻腾的寂灭黑雾骤然稀薄大半，再也无法维持圆满攻势。
他，终归是败下阵来。
此刻再看二人战力根基，差距展露无遗。
对手以寂灭道韵，红月异象凝化的寂灭神枪，早已布满密密麻麻的细碎裂痕，枪身灵光黯淡、道纹破碎，无数万古积淀的法理之力飞速溃散，濒临崩碎损毁，再也无力承载巅峰战力。

反观词宋手中的圣人至宝说难剑，历经十五日无尽厮杀、万千次极致对撞，剑身依旧澄澈光亮、崭新无瑕，周身萦绕的圣贤正气愈发浑厚磅礴，道道金纹流转不息，圣人威压浩荡凛然、亘古未衰，分毫没有半分损耗疲态，仙兵底蕴尽显无遗。
只是词宋此刻也绝非安然无恙。
不知岁月流转，他们不眠不休、耗尽心神本源的极致鏖战，无数道韵创伤层层累积，早已让二人遍体鳞伤。
词宋满身衣衫尽数被金色血液浸透，肌理之上新旧伤口交错纵横，金色血痂覆满周身，发丝凝着血泽，整个人宛若一尊浴血征战的金色血人。
content_en:
If any monk in the same realm in the world had to endure such a war wound that envelops the principles of the Dao, his veins would have been broken, his Dao foundation would have been damaged, he would have been seriously injured and on the verge of death, and his fighting power would have been lost. Even the top genius from ancient times would never be able to bear the weight and fight again.
But both of them are supreme beings who have realized the Tao in the flesh and replaced the heaven with their bodies. The texture of the whole body is perfect and flawless. The toughness of their bodies far exceeds the limits of the heavens. They have already transcended the shackles of injuries of ordinary monks.
These fatal injuries, which were enough to shock people in the same realm, fell on the two of them. They were just skin injuries and damage to the texture. They could not shake the foundation of the origin at all, let alone hinder the slightest bit of combat power.
Guns and swords came and went, and the offensive was still fast and fierce, breaking the sky. The advance and retreat were still calm and smooth, and the killing and fighting spirit around him had not weakened by half. Only the blood all over his body bore witness to the danger of this fierce battle.
Although the battle seems to be evenly matched, only Ci Song, who is at the center of the game, knows full well that the gap between the two has been quietly revealed in countless confrontations.
The opponent's physical path is fully mature and approaching its perfection, but in the end it is a mundane path trapped in the laws of the heavens, with an endless foundation and an upper limit. However, he carries the original origin of the Dao and the remaining power of the Heavenly Dao, and has gone through the ultimate peak of the Immortal Dao to rebuild his path.
Since the beginning of the war, he has been steadily suppressing the opponent's front line. Every time he collides, he can quietly remove 30% of the opponent's strength. Every time he crosses, he can use his original level to crush the opponent's Tao Yun. It seems that they are in a stalemate, but in fact, the opponent is passive and reluctant at every step, and he is vaguely checking and balancing the whole process.
The difference is subtle, but it is real. Over time, it becomes a world of difference.
Thousands of moves are fleeting, and ten thousand moves pass by in a hurry.
Time loses its meaning in the fight, the long river of time flows, and no one counts the changes of day and night.
Time passed quietly, and the two kept fighting fiercely in the cracks of time. Their guns and swords never stopped, and their fighting spirit never faded.
The two fought hard, and the opponent's offensive gradually lost its initial fierceness and fierceness. There was a bit of sluggishness between the ups and downs, and the consumption of physical resources became more and more obvious. However, Ci Song still advanced and retreated calmly, with a steady offensive, and his Tao power flowed endlessly, without any signs of exhaustion.
Time passed by, and the long and fierce battles that lasted for an unknown amount of time, and the extreme competition spanning endless years, finally wore away the last illusion of equality.
Boom!
The light and shadow in the upper reaches of the long river of time quietly shifted, and the last extreme collision of guns and swords exploded into a torrential wave of weather.
This time, the jet-black Dragon Spear of Nirvana trembled violently, and the eternal dragon patterns lingering around the gun's body shattered into pieces. The powerful and domineering time sequence power suddenly broke off and was unable to continue.
The mysterious figure shook violently and staggered back several feet. The black mist of annihilation that rolled around him suddenly thinned out by half, and he could no longer maintain a perfect offensive.
He was defeated after all.
Now if we look at the foundation of the two's combat power, the gap is clearly revealed.
The opponent's Nirvana Divine Spear, which was condensed with the rhyme of Nirvana and the vision of the red moon, was already covered with dense cracks. The aura of the gun body was dim, the Dao lines were broken, and the power of law accumulated over countless eternities quickly dissipated. It was on the verge of collapse and damage, and could no longer carry its peak combat power.
On the other hand, the sage's most precious sword, the Difficult Sword, in Ci Song's hands, after fifteen days of endless fighting and thousands of extreme collisions, the sword is still clear, bright, brand new and flawless.
It's just that Ci Song is by no means safe and sound at this moment.
Unknown to the passage of time, they fought endlessly and intensely, exhausting their mental resources. Countless Tao Yun wounds accumulated layer by layer, leaving both of them covered with bruises.
Ci Song's clothes were completely soaked with golden blood. Old and new wounds were crisscrossed on the texture. Golden blood scabs covered his whole body. His hair was covered with blood. His whole body was like a golden bloody man in a bloody battle.
